preregistered_at_stage: Before any current-analyzer predictions on these36cases
purpose: Competition-readiness development diagnostic, not population accuracy, field validation or user study.
constraints: No app/rule tuning on this diagnostic
No private content, spam-as-fraud labels or actual received-message claims
All outcomes including misses and extra concerns retained

metrics.warning: Any weighted evidence item (>0). Alignment scored only for Boolean expectations; null ambiguous labels remain unscored.
metrics.specific_actions: Presence of preregistered action themes in fixed action titles. Generic separate-route verification is reported separately and cannot count as a specific match.
metrics.uncertainty: risk_index null, confidence low, model_ran false and decision_basis rules; does not establish correct calibration or contextual understanding.
metrics.action_usefulness: Every row reports present/missing desired themes and a fixed interpretation: all desired themes present, partial, or generic-only. This is a proxy plus case-specific rationale, not a user rating.
metrics.timing: One local sequential in-process analysis+guidance call per case, imports excluded. Descriptive, not a performance guarantee.

action_title_map.code: Keep security codes and passwords private
action_title_map.overpayment: Do not return the difference yet
action_title_map.callback: End the call and call back independently
